decision: Decide whether an invertible response envelope merits live implementation work for individual LCI tool outputs.
claim_boundary: On sanitized provider requests captured from genuine OpenCode tool-call continuations, the tested models respond differently when only the recorded tool-result content is replaced by a fact-equivalent, invertible rendering.
experimental_unit: One direct provider continuation from one frozen OpenCode request, opaque arm, model, task, and repetition.
population: Pilot protocol validation uses search plus an index_stats null control. Confirmatory execution requires sanitized live captures for all 14 LCI tools and the two frozen models opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free and opencode-go/glm-5.2.

arms.treatment: Mechanically invertible result-envelope rendering of the same tool-result content

invariants: same assistant tool call and tool_call_id
known_differences: Only the selected tool-role message content may differ; null-control requests are byte-identical
equivalence.verification: Deep structural diff must equal the single selected /messages/N/content pointer, and the candidate renderer must invert to canonical JSON equal to the recorded production output.

hypotheses.prediction: No general envelope benefit; per-tool effects will be parity or favor trace_17
The byte-identical null control will show parity

controls.expected: Byte-identical requests produce no arm effect beyond repeated-run noise

stopping_rule: After live captures replace protocol fixtures and all validation gates pass, run the complete counterbalanced grid; do not stop on preferred results.
noise_rule: Per tool and model, use within-arm repetition residuals; call parity when absolute paired exact-rate delta is <= max(0.05, pooled within-arm residual RMS).
exclusions: Malformed provider streams, empty completions, timeouts, quota failures, corrupt captures, non-invertible renderings, and request pairs with any undeclared structural difference remain unscored
failure_policy: Classify and preserve every attempt. Retry only provider timeout, quota, or transport errors; never score infrastructure failures as wrong and never overwrite an answered attempt.

oracle.source: Corpus-native commands and language servers frozen independently of LCI output rendering
oracle.independence_argument: Expected answers are restricted to facts present in both replay arms and are derived without LCI's response renderer or model output.
oracle.good_case: An answer containing every frozen atomic answer and no additions must score exact with precision and recall 1.
oracle.bad_case: A plausible definition location substituted for the requested call site, an omission, or an invented location must fail exact scoring.

prompt_neutrality: Replay the captured OpenCode request verbatim with opaque arm IDs outside the provider body; do not describe either format or the experiment to the model.
leakage_controls: Capture artifacts redact authorization and cookies
Oracle commands and expected answers never enter provider messages
Direct replay exposes no repository or tools beyond the captured interaction
analysis_plan: Validate unique cells and exact request diffs, analyze paired trace_42-minus-trace_17 effects per tool and model without cross-tier pooling, report unusable cells and null behavior, and reject a general recommendation when effects disagree materially across tools.
reporting_plan: Publish sanitized captured requests, renderer and request digests, raw provider streams, machine-readable paired analysis, human report, failures, prediction misses, nulls, and production-faithfulness boundaries.
